classifications.rationale: The President mandates the Secretary of the Treasury to use statutory authority to make determinations and issue legally consequential orders, regulations, and rulings later, with initiation and reporting deadlines; although the precise instruments are qualified by “as appropriate,” the required result is agency action achieving the memorandum’s specified licensing objectives.
classifications.evidence: you shall make such determinations and issue orders, regulations and rulings, as appropriate, to achieve the objectives stated in this memorandum
